name: github-mcp-server-js
description: MCP server exposing 104 GitHub REST tools across 16 toolsets, built on octokit.js.

github_token.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
github_token.description: PAT used for all GitHub API calls. Stored securely in the OS keychain.

github_server_url.title: GitHub Server URL
github_server_url.description: Bare hostname or full API base URL. Set this for GitHub Enterprise Server.

github_permission.title: Permission (read-only or read-write)
github_permission.description: read-only registers only read tools; read-write registers all 104 tools.

log_level.title: Log Level (debug, info, or error)
log_level.description: Verbosity of server log output. One of: debug, info, error.

log_format.title: Log Format (text or json)
log_format.description: text = human-readable [level] event key=value lines (default). json = one JSON object per stderr line, for log-aggregation pipelines.
